narrator_lines: Attention, Station Omega crew. This is Mission Control.
A massive solar flare has struck the station. Primary stabilizers are offline.
Your orbit around the red giant is decaying. You have approximately fifteen minutes.
All hands to stations. Begin emergency recovery procedures immediately.

phases.narrator_intro: All crew, set your stations to starting positions. Confirm each control when your display lights green.

narrator_lines_ambient: Focus on restoring core systems.
Station integrity is holding... for now.
Orbital decay rate: accelerating.
Keep those hands moving, crew.

narrator_lines: Impressive work. Core systems are back online and the station is holding steady.
We've bought you some time. Now chart an escape trajectory and prep the engines.
Systems are still critical. The station is drifting closer to the star.
You need to work harder. Much harder. This is life or death, people.

narrator_lines_ambient: Trajectory calculations underway — keep the station stable!
Engine preheating. Looking good.
Stay coordinated. This is the hard part.
Two escape vectors identified. We need to lock one in.
Warning: hull temperature rising.
We're losing compartments on the lower decks.
The star's corona is visible through the viewports now.
Don't give up. Focus!

narrator_lines: Escape trajectory locked! Engines at eighty percent and climbing!
One final push. Fire the sequence and ride the burn out of here.
The trajectory was right, but the engines aren't cooperating.
We've lost primary ignition. You need to restart from backup systems.
Against all odds, you've stabilized the station!
We have a narrow escape window. Take it. NOW.
This is as bad as it gets. Station integrity at forty percent.
Last chance. Everything you have, or you burn with the station.

narrator_lines_ambient: Engines firing! Keep the burn steady!
Escape velocity is within range!
Almost clear — do NOT lose focus now.
The star is receding. Hold the course!
Backup ignition is sluggish — keep trying!
Come on, come on — we need those engines!
The escape window is closing!
More power! We need more power!
This is your shot — do not waste it!
Every system needs to work perfectly!
The star's gravity is fighting us — push through!
Keep that momentum going!
Warning: structural collapse imminent!
We are in the red zone! Every second counts!
This is it — all or nothing!
The hull is buckling — MOVE!

WWW.title: Textbook Escape
narrator_lines: Station Omega breaks free. Engines at full burn. The star recedes behind you.
That was textbook emergency response. Every order executed. Every crisis handled.
Mission Control is recommending this entire crew for commendation.
Well done, Station Omega. Well done.

WWL.title: Rough Exit
narrator_lines: The escape burn fires, but it's rough. The engine stuttered at the worst moment.
Station Omega pulls free. You're alive and heading home.
That last phase cost you a perfect run. But alive beats perfect every time.

WLW.title: Hard Recovery
narrator_lines: After a shaky middle phase, you pulled it together when it counted.
The escape burn is clean. Station Omega is clear.
Lost a chunk of the station in the process, but the crew is intact. Well recovered.

WLL.title: Limping Home
narrator_lines: Station Omega tears free of the gravity well, but pieces of the hull are peeling off.
Life support is failing. Emergency pods are prepped.
You're alive. Barely. That started so well. What happened?

LWW.title: Comeback Crew
narrator_lines: What a comeback. A terrible start — but the crew found its rhythm.
The escape burn is strong. Station Omega is heading home.
That first phase had us worried. Glad you proved us wrong.

LWL.title: Pyrrhic Escape
narrator_lines: The station limps to safe distance. Half the compartments are venting atmosphere.
Escape pods are on standby. It's not pretty, but you survived.
Inconsistency almost killed you today.

LLW.title: Eleventh Hour
narrator_lines: A miracle at the eleventh hour.
The station was minutes from breaking apart and somehow you fired the engines.
Station Omega is clear. Barely. Do not count on miracles twice.

LLL.title: Station Lost
narrator_lines: Critical failure. Station Omega has lost all structural integrity.
The emergency beacon fires one last signal into the void.
Station Omega falls into the star. All hands lost.

between_commands_lines: Time is not on our side.
Don't stop. Don't think. Just do it.
